# Course profile fixtures

HTML fixtures are reduced sections captured from official course pages on 2026-10-11. They retain the source wording and section boundary. Stepik JSON is a sanitized previously captured API response; the fresh request returned HTTP 502. Netology's fresh request timed out, so its section contract is exercised only by synthetic mutations.

JavaRush's selected Premium card and Hexlet's promotional text deliberately establish no profile. Requirements advertised for a job, another tariff, or recommended course are not evidence about admission. Tests explicitly mark generated contract mutations as synthetic; they do not demonstrate live source coverage.
